results.description:
One night destroyed everything I loved—my family, my peace, my future.

Now baseball is the only thing keeping me together. It’s the one dream I refuse to lose, even if stepping onto the field means battling panic attacks, whispers from my past, and a teammate determined to see me fail.
Then Kade Maxwell crashes into my world. Literally.

One collision in the school parking lot. One heated moment in a janitor’s closet where his copper eyes lock on mine and the air crackles with tension. He’s cocky, magnetic, and impossible to ignore—the kind of boy who turns my entire world upside down with a single touch.

And the most dangerous part? He makes me feel safe again.

Kade has enemies. Secrets. And a past that steers me straight into the line of fire.

Now someone is targeting me, I’m spiraling, and the boy who makes me feel alive again may destroy everything I’ve fought to rebuild.

My dreams. My future. My heart.

And if I’m not careful, the boy helping me heal could shatter me completely.

Dare to Kiss is a new adult sports romance featuring a determined heroine, a protective hero who falls first, emotional healing, suspense, and a small-town family readers will fall in love with.

Maxwell Series Reading Order:
1.     Dare to Kiss
2.     Dare to Dream
3.     Dare to Love
4.     Dare to Dance
5.     Dare to Live
6.     Dare to Breathe
7.     Dare to Embrace
